title: Iron Legion general rules (content/rules/general.json5)
description: Engine tunables for generals and their auras (Simulation Spec 9 and 15.1). One merged object per enabled mod set; every field is required because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

aura_radius.description: Metres around the general within which allied anchors get the aura (SIM-GEN-002).

aura_attack.description: Attack bonus fraction inside the aura (SIM-GEN-002).

aura_per_rank.description: Metres of aura radius per general rank (SIM-GEN-002).

hp_mult.description: Hit point multiplier of the general soldier (SIM-GEN-001).

wounded_hp.description: Hit point fraction below which a surviving general is Wounded (SIM-GEN-004).
